entries.6513b04b7477f5fb: A reportable segment grouping the services provided to the national government, local governments and companies. The securities report says that, against the background of the creation of the "Furusato Resident Registration System", new commissioned projects increased in the areas of related population and travel, and the total number of projects commissioned by the national and local governments in fiscal 2025 was 67, exceeding the target of 60 and the highest ever in a single year.

entries.6e14e3ce15bf8282: Operating loss for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥7,221 thousand (operating loss of ¥155,811 thousand in the previous fiscal year), and ordinary profit was ¥20,518 thousand (ordinary loss of ¥160,490 thousand in the previous fiscal year); the annual securities report states that this marked the first return to ordinary profit since listing. Non-operating income includes subsidy income of ¥26,377 thousand. Extraordinary losses included an impairment loss on goodwill of ¥29,362 thousand, and net loss was ¥4,146 thousand (net loss of ¥163,866 thousand in the previous fiscal year). The annual securities report states that selling, general and administrative expenses fell 17.1% year on year, due to a temporary increase in shipping costs paid under subsidy projects in the previous fiscal year, the start of capitalizing development costs, and reduced company-wide costs from more efficient organizational management; it also states that the company has recorded net losses since its founding.

entries.848005b7584396fd: [[term:annual-securities-report|Annual securities report]] states that the company has set the mission of “mixing cities and regions” and operates mainly food, travel and local government businesses in two [[term:segment|reportable segments]]: “Services for Individuals” and “Services for Corporations.” The core is the farm-direct app “Pocket Marche,” which lets users buy ingredients directly from producers they can see; sales commissions on transactions form the foundation of its revenue. Using the network of producers and consumers built there, the company also handles furusato nōzei, planned travel for children, an accommodation booking site, and entrusted projects for local governments. The company does not prepare consolidated financial statements, and the figures are those of the company on a non-consolidated basis. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥1,027,929 thousand (up 0.6% year on year).

entries.93e6089834fe4441: This is the marriage matchmaking service "Chihokon!," opened in October 2024. It offers members living in rural areas, acquired through registered producers of "Pocket Marche" and their connections, and members living in cities, acquired through Web media, opportunities to be matched with about 90,000 marriage-seeking members held by IBJ, a matchmaking agency federation, and earns revenue from marriage counseling, arranging of meetings, relationship management and other services. The securities report does not state this segment's sales on its own.

entries.9b1ffad62cdf4d13: Operation of the direct-from-producer app "Pocket Marche", a subscription service that delivers food regularly, the platform for "Taberu Tsushin", an information magazine bundled with food, and the hometown tax donation platform "Pokemaru Furusato Nozei". "Pocket Marche" is a service where people buy food while communicating directly with farmers and fishers across Japan; it has been offered since September 2016 and earns revenue from sales commissions on transactions. As of the end of December 2025, about 9,000 producers are registered and about 14,000 items are listed. "Taberu Tsushin" is published in 15 regions across Japan and earns commission fees from the publishers that belong to the "Japan Taberu Tsushin League". "Pokemaru Furusato Nozei" is a mechanism in which items produced within the area of a contracted municipality automatically become return gifts, and it earns revenue from fees from municipalities and sales commissions from producers. The securities report also mentions the streamlining of low-profitability in-house developed products.
entries.9beee0c5bf16f472: Revenue from subscription services sold by the company as the principal.
entries.9d4da9be1016c486: A reportable segment grouping the services provided to individual consumers, including the direct-from-producer food app "Pocket Marche" where food can be bought directly from producers, hometown tax donations, planned travel for children, an accommodation booking site and a matchmaking service. Of the two reportable segments, it is the one with the larger sales to external customers. For the fiscal year ended December 2025, sales were ¥726,237 thousand (down 3.7% from the previous year) and segment profit (operating profit) was ¥170,876 thousand (operating profit of ¥73,591 thousand in the previous year). The securities report says that, amid rising prices, selling, general and administrative expenses were reduced through more efficient operations, and the profitability of the food business improved greatly from the previous year. From the current fiscal year, the former single segment "Related Population Creation Business" was changed into two segments, Consumer Services and Corporate Services, and the previous year's figures have been restated under the new classification.
entries.a286dfebe3d27d82: Operation of "Pokemaru Oyako Chiho Ryugaku", a planned trip for children, and "STAY JAPAN", an accommodation booking site. "Pokemaru Oyako Chiho Ryugaku" is a program in which parents and children visit a production area, the parents work remotely while the children experience nature with producers, and it earns revenue from participants. In summer 2025 it was held in 7 regions across Japan, with 186 families and 475 people taking part, compared with 143 families in the previous year. "STAY JAPAN" is a site listing about 1,000 accommodations such as private lodgings, farm stays and traditional old-house stays, and the business was acquired from Hyakusen Renma Co., Ltd. in April 2025. It arranges for the accommodations to provide services to guests and earns commission income.
